decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certifies that on 26 April 2007, the erection of a side and rear roof extension and the installation of two roof lights to the front roof plane, as shown on drawing numbers AA[LD]75100, AA[LD]75101 and AA[LD]75102 received 26 April 2007, adding a volume of 35.75m3 to the house, and making the total volume of extensions to the original volume of the house 69.85m3 (taking into account the volume of the existing single storey rear extension), was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
Following the proposed extension, consisting of a side and rear roof extension and the installation of two roof lights to the front roof plane of the dwellinghouse, the resulting building would fall within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class B, of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of a side and rear roof extension and installation of two rooflights to the front of the dwellinghouse
